name: Runemaster audit #2758: Runic Affinity extends Zenith's duration by 6 seconds
contract: Runic Affinity 705621: 'Increases the duration of Zenith by $/1000;s1 sec.' Re-verified in Spell.dbc: single
Effect0 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), MiscValue 1 = SPELLMOD_DURATION, EffectBasePoints0 5999 with
DieSides 1 = +6000ms, EffectSpellClassMask mask0 268435456 (0x10000000) on family 38. Both DBC spells named
Zenith (712325, and its 2-charge upgrade 712389) carry SpellFamilyName 38, SpellFamilyFlags[0] 268435456 -
an exact match on both. This is the native AzerothCore spellmod system (SPELLMOD_DURATION applied before
SpellInfo::GetDuration/CalcDuration); no occurrence of 705621 exists in src/server/coa/.
Verification note: a live re-cast of Zenith is not a safe discriminator here. Zenith's own cooldown is
additionally governed by src/server/coa/AscensionRunemasterEchoes.cpp, a custom 'Echoes' cooldown-pooling
ledger shared with its 2-charge variant 712389 (stored via Player::UpdatePlayerSetting under
'core.runemaster.echoes' and a 'core.spell_charge.712389' charge pool). Recasting Zenith right after
resetting only its plain m_spellCooldowns entry (RemoveSpellCooldown) still fails with
SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY (67) end to end, confirmed live: cooldown_ms read 0 immediately after reset and
after a 2s wait, yet the second CMSG_CAST_SPELL was still rejected - the ledger enforces its own recovery
state independent of the plain cooldown map, and the harness has no action to clear it. Expected: instead,
probe SPELLMOD_DURATION directly via the generic spell_modifier metric (the same native ApplySpellMod path
SpellInfo::GetDuration/CalcDuration consumes), which needs no cast/cooldown/ledger interaction at all -
before the talent the op-1 probe against 712325 is unmodified; with Runic Affinity learned it rises by
